messages:
alisa: Hey benefits team — I'm traveling from OR and tried to book a telehealth visit with Dr. Mira Kim (WA office). The insurer portal flags her as out-of-network for me even though Acme's provider directory shows her as in-network in WA. I'm on the Redwood PPO Gold plan. Anyone seen multi-state mismatches like this?

sam_people_ops: Ugh, yeah this happens when the insurer's geo-mapping uses member home state vs. provider license state. Did you confirm the NPI?

alisa: NPI 1234567890. Provider page: https://provider.acmehealth.com/Dr-Mira-Kim (shows in-network). Portal screenshot attached — it says "OON for your plan". No idea which state the portal thinks I'm in.

ben-hr: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm member address on file (insurer uses that). 2) Confirm plan network is national vs state-limited. 3) If telehealth, sometimes licensure rules still apply.

sam_people_ops: Can you DM me the member's zip and last 4 of member ID? I'll open a broker ticket.

alisa: DM sent. Zip 97205, member ID last4 4821.

broker-julia: Thanks — I'm on it. From experience Acme sometimes indexes telehealth providers under the state where their practice is primarily located. If your telehealth session is billed out of WA but the member's address is OR, the portal UI can show OON even if claims pay correctly. I'll escalate and request a network mapping check.

insurance-bot: Case created with Acme Support: CASE-ACME-202403-9982. Status: open.

ben-hr: If Acme says claims would still be paid in-network, note that in case you want to proceed with the appointment. If not, broker can request a manual override or prompt the provider to update taxonomy/address.

alisa: Appreciate it. One follow-up — do we need to provide a proof of enrollment or ID card for telehealth? I don't want the provider to deny at check-in.

broker-julia: Usually just the member ID and name. For safety, screenshot your digital ID card and bring the Acme provider directory link. If they ask, request provider billing NPI match and ask the provider to confirm they'd bill under their in-network tax ID.

sam_people_ops: Update: Acme asked for both member DOB and provider W-9 tax address to reconcile. Julia, can you request the provider's billing address?

broker-julia: Yep — pinged Dr. Kim's office for billing address and will add to CASE-ACME-202403-9982.

alisa: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the appointment for now and cancel if Acme confirms OON. :thumbsup: 

insurance-bot: CASE-ACME-202403-9982 updated: awaiting provider billing address.

ben-hr: Filing note in our benefits tracker: "multi-state telehealth: portal shows OON despite directory listing; broker escalated" — will keep closed-loop once case resolves.

alisa: Closing loop — Dr. Kim's office confirmed billing under WA group tax address. Julia confirmed Acme updated their mapping and marked in-network for my member. Case closed. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
